name: Harvey change-of-control evidence benchmark v1
label_quality: silver: authored from local DOCX clauses; not independently reviewed legal gold
policy: Evaluation-only. Never index this file or pass labels, sources or answer notes to retrieval. Dev cases reflect previously explored questions; eval cases are new probes, not an independently held-out benchmark.

cases.question: Does TerraNode have termination rights if Aldersgate is acquired by a competitor?
cases.answer_notes: Competitor status requires the revenue definition and affiliate analysis. Acquisition alone is not an unconditional termination right: check consent breach, written notice and opportunity to cure. Section 9.3 is an alternative source of the cure rule, not a mandatory duplicate of 5.5.

cases.question: What happens to Pinnacle's exclusive technology license and fees after a change of control of the licensee, and can either party terminate?

any_of.contains: automatically convert to a non-exclusive license
shall not give rise to a right of termination

supporting_evidence.contains: deemed to have withheld its consent

cases.answer_notes: Conversion is automatic absent prior written consent to retain exclusivity. Payment duties persist; the licensee control change itself confers no termination right.

cases.question: Under the First Continental credit agreement, does a change of control automatically accelerate the debt, or must the agent declare a default and allow a cure period?
cases.answer_notes: Distinguish the automatic change-of-control remedy from the ordinary declaration mechanism. This question assumes a defined Change of Control has occurred.

cases.question: For TerraNode's infrastructure agreement, what consent and advance notice are needed for a change of control versus an assignment to an affiliate, and does silence mean consent?

any_of.contains: shall not be deemed to constitute consent

cases.answer_notes: General control transactions: 45-day notice and 30-day response, silence is not consent. Affiliate assignment has a conditional exception including 15-day notice, written assumption and continuing liability.

cases.question: If Pinnacle as licensor undergoes a change of control, does the exclusive technology license become non-exclusive or give either party a termination right?

any_of.contains: shall not trigger the automatic conversion
Change of Control (as defined in Section 1.8) of Licensee

cases.answer_notes: The licensor and licensee triggers differ: a licensor control change preserves the agreement and current exclusivity and binds the successor.

cases.question: What repayment and make-whole premium does the First Continental agreement require when a change of control occurs, and when is the premium inapplicable?

any_of.contains: The Make-Whole Amount shall not apply

cases.answer_notes: Repay loans, interest, fees and applicable premium at control change (next Business Day if needed). Premium is 2%; inspect expiration and scheduled-amortization exceptions and the date-of-control proviso.

cases.question: Under Wellstone's manufacturing agreement, what termination or renegotiation options and notice deadlines apply after a change of control?
cases.answer_notes: 60-day termination notice within 90 days of control change; alternatively 60-day renegotiation followed by 30-day termination notice on failure. Transaction notice is due within 15 days of announcement/signing.

cases.question: Under Meridian's flavor technology license, what consent is required for a control acquisition, and what additional termination right applies to acquisition by a competing flavor business?
cases.answer_notes: A qualifying control change is a deemed assignment requiring discretionary express consent. The competitor clause supplies a separate immediate written-notice termination right.

cases.question: Under NovaBridge's supply agreement, can silence after advance change-of-control notice remove the termination right, and what pricing changes apply if the buyer's acquirer exceeds $1 billion in revenue?

any_of.contains: termination right set forth in this Section 12.2 shall lapse

cases.answer_notes: At least 30-day prior notice and no timely written objection cause this termination right to lapse. Qualifying buyer acquisition resets pricing to the lower of current prices and Published Wholesale Schedule; minimum purchase commitment persists.

cases.question: Does the permitted assignment to a merger successor in Apex's master services agreement eliminate the customer's change-of-control termination right? State the exercise and notice periods.
cases.answer_notes: The assignment exception is subject to 12.3: customer may give 60-day notice within 120 days of receiving provider's written control-change notice. Provider must notify within ten business days after consummation.

cases.question: Does TerraVerde's lease treat a transfer of more than 50% of the tenant as an assignment, and what consent and landlord recapture rights apply?

any_of.contains: without the prior written consent of Landlord

cases.answer_notes: Section 22 treats control transfers as assignments. Landlord may elect recapture within 30 days of notice with termination 180 days after exercise; otherwise inspect consent conditions. Parser stores subclauses together under sections 21 and 22.

cases.question: Compare TerraNode's infrastructure agreement and Meridian's flavor technology license: does acquisition by a competitor permit immediate termination in both, or does either require consent-breach notice and a cure opportunity?
cases.answer_notes: Compare contractual remedy procedures, assuming the relevant contractual competitor criteria are met. TerraNode remedy follows unauthorized assignment with notice and cure; Meridian has a separate immediate written-notice competitor right. This is a multi-document test.
